04
How Can We Have Faith?
Some people are at their best in the morning, others come to life at 
night. My best time of day is first thing. I wake up full of energy but 
as the day goes on I begin to fade. By nine o’clock at night I am ready 
to go to bed. By ten o’clock I am falling asleep. By eleven o’clock I am 
asleep, wherever I happen to be!
I have always been like that, even when I was at university. At the end 
of my last term there I attended our college ball. That evening I met 
a girl whom I had talked to a couple of times before. She was about 
the same age as me. We started chatting and then we danced. Eleven
